# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/001
Date: 10 January 2026
Subject: Admission schedule for WBBSE schools in the district

This circular applies to all schools affiliated with the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education (WBBSE). Application forms for Class V admission will be available from 1 February 2026 and the last date for submission is 28 February 2026. The admission lottery will be held on 15 March 2026.

A child must be at least 9 years old on 1 January 2026 to apply for Class V. The age limit for Class I admission is 5 years. Schools such as Hare School, Bethune Collegiate School and Tantia High School must display the schedule on their notice boards.
Parents may submit queries to the District Education Office in Howrah or Salkia. Under Rule 3 of the district admission guidelines, no school may charge a fee for the application form.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/002
Date: 15 January 2026
Subject: Seat matrix and age limit for CBSE schools

This circular applies to all schools affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The minimum age for Class I admission is 6 years as on 31 March 2026. Admissions follow the lottery described in the district lottery guidelines.

Approved seats for Class I:
| School | Seats |
|---|---|
| Delhi Public School | 150 |
| Don Bosco School | 120 |
| Heritage Academy | 90 |
| Narain Dass Bangur Memorial Multipurpose School | 100 |
| Nava Nalanda Group of Schools | 80 |
Heritage Academy and Nava Nalanda Group of Schools must complete registration by 31 January 2026.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/003
Date: 20 January 2026
Subject: Seat matrix and age limit for ICSE schools

This circular applies to all schools affiliated with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (ICSE). The minimum age for Class I admission is 5 years. Admissions follow the lottery described in the district lottery guidelines.

Approved seats for Class I:
| School | Seats |
|---|---|
| Saint Xavier's Collegiate School | 90 |
| St. Jude's High School | 70 |
| Holy Cross School | 80 |
| The Calcutta Emmanuel School | 60 |
| Auxilium Convent School | 50 |
| Harrow Hall | 40 |
The new ICSE school Sunrise International School in Salt Lake has been allotted 55 seats. St Xavier's Collegiate School will publish its registration list by 10 February 2026.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/004
Date: 5 February 2026
Subject: Revised admission schedule for WBBSE schools
This circular supersedes Circular DEO/ADM/2026/001 dated 10 January 2026.

For WBBSE schools the last date for Class V application is extended to 10 March 2026 and the admission lottery will be held on 25 March 2026. All other conditions, including the age limit of 9 years, remain unchanged.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/005
Date: 12 February 2026
Subject: Reservation for economically weaker sections (EWS)
This circular applies to all schools affiliated with CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE. Under Rule 4(1), 25 percent of seats in Class I must be reserved for children from economically weaker sections (EWS).

Under Rule 5, an applicant must submit an income certificate showing annual family income below Rs. 120000. Schools such as Delhi Public School and Don Bosco School must publish the number of EWS seats on their websites.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/008
Date: 1 March 2026
Subject: Mid-session transfer admissions
Under Rule 7, a student seeking transfer must produce a transfer certificate issued by the previous school. Vacancies must be filled within 30 days of the notice.
This circular applies to schools affiliated with CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE. Dum Dum Krishna Kumar Hindu Academy and Pandit Motilal Institute have reported vacancies.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/009
Date: 5 March 2026
Subject: Road safety near schools
This circular applies to schools affiliated with CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE. Schools located on the following roads must install speed breakers and zebra crossings within 45 days.

Schools on Barrackpore Trunk Road: Baranagar Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama High School, Sri Ramkrishna Vidyasram, Dum Dum Krishna Kumar Hindu Academy, Dum Dum Baidyanath Institution, Auxilium Convent School.
Schools on AJC Bose Road: The Calcutta Emmanuel School, Chittaranjan Girls High School, Kamala Chatterjee Girls School, Chittaranjan Boys High School, Nava Nalanda Group of Schools.

Schools on Grand Trunk Road: Delhi Public School, Rajarhat Shiksha Niketan High School for Boys, Rajarhat Shiksha Niketan High School for Girls, Narain Dass Bangur Memorial Multipurpose School, Pandit Motilal Institute.
Schools on Diamond Harbour Road: St. Jude's High School, Debiswari Girl's High School, Bethune Collegiate School, Hare School, Tantia High School.
Schools on Belgachia Road: Hindu Girl's School, B.K.Paul's Institution, Dinabandhu Institution Main, Vivekananda School, Heritage Academy.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/011
Date: 18 March 2026
Subject: Revised income ceiling for EWS applicants
This circular supersedes Circular DEO/ADM/2026/005 and applies to schools affiliated with CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE.
Under Rule 5 (as amended), the annual family income ceiling is revised to Rs. 150000.
Rule 4(1) is unchanged: 25 percent of Class I seats remain reserved for EWS children.

# Circular No. DEO/ADM/2026/012
Date: 2 April 2026
Subject: Revised seat matrix for CBSE schools

| Don Bosco School | 120 |
| Heritage Academy | 100 |
| Narain Dass Bangur Memorial Multipurpose School | 100 |
| Nava Nalanda Group of Schools | 90 |
| Lakeview Public School | 70 |
The new CBSE school Lakeview Public School has been allotted 70 seats. Delhi Public School has the most seats (160 seats).

Guidelines for admission lotteries
Issued on 5 January 2026
Rule 2.3: The lottery draw must be held in the presence of at least 3 parents chosen by the school.
Rule 2.5: The waiting list remains valid for 60 days after the draw.
These guidelines apply to schools affiliated with CBSE, ICSE and WBBSE.

Notes on schools, localities and roads in the district
Compiled on 10 April 2026
This note lists where the schools mentioned in district circulars are located. Locations come from the Geo-Server layers.
In Bally, the schools covered by district circulars are Debiswari Girl's High School (WBBSE).
In Ballygunge, the schools covered by district circulars are Chittaranjan Girls High School (WBBSE), Chittaranjan Boys High School (WBBSE), Kamala Chatterjee Girls School (WBBSE).
In Baranagar, the schools covered by district circulars are Baranagar Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama High School (WBBSE).
In Belgachia, the schools covered by district circulars are Bethune Collegiate School (WBBSE).

In Dum Dum, the schools covered by district circulars are St. Jude's High School (ICSE), Rajarhat Shiksha Niketan High School for Boys (WBBSE), Rajarhat Shiksha Niketan High School for Girls (WBBSE), Narain Dass Bangur Memorial Multipurpose School (CBSE), Dum Dum Baidyanath Institution (WBBSE), Dum Dum Krishna Kumar Hindu Academy (WBBSE), Auxilium Convent School (ICSE), Pandit Motilal Institute (WBBSE), Sri Ramkrishna Vidyasram (WBBSE).
In Entally, the schools covered by district circulars are Holy Cross School (ICSE), Hare School (WBBSE), Tantia High School (WBBSE).
In Howrah, the schools covered by district circulars are Heritage Academy (CBSE), B.K.Paul's Institution (WBBSE).
In Jadavpur, the schools covered by district circulars are The Calcutta Emmanuel School (ICSE).
In Park Street, the schools covered by district circulars are Don Bosco School (CBSE), Saint Xavier's Collegiate School (ICSE), Harrow Hall (ICSE).
In Salt Lake, the schools covered by district circulars are Delhi Public School (CBSE).
In Shibpur, the schools covered by district circulars are Hindu Girl's School (WBBSE), Kabitirtha Vidyalaya (WBBSE), Dinabandhu Institution Main (WBBSE), Vivekananda School (WBBSE).
In Tollygunge, the schools covered by district circulars are Nava Nalanda Group of Schools (CBSE).
The main roads covered by the road safety circular are Barrackpore Trunk Road, AJC Bose Road, Grand Trunk Road, Diamond Harbour Road, Belgachia Road.

Land use: Howrah is mainly residential; Shibpur is mainly commercial; Bally is mainly park; Park Street is mainly commercial; Ballygunge is mainly residential; Tollygunge is mainly park; Jadavpur is mainly commercial; Salt Lake is mainly residential; Dum Dum is mainly industrial; Baranagar is mainly residential; Belgachia is mainly commercial; Entally is mainly residential.
